comment: Consent and provenance should not be reduced to a simple access flag. Research use may depend on the approved protocol, ethics committee conditions, data-access requirements and, where material is distributed, material-transfer obligations.

anchor.note: p.157 l.111–121 read as the printed page

public.text: Consent and provenance should not be reduced to a simple access flag. Research use may depend on the approved protocol, ethics committee conditions, data-access requirements and, where material is distributed, material-transfer obligations.
public.suggestedRevision: Ensure consent records retain consent version, date, study/protocol identifier, ethics approval reference, permitted purposes, review or expiry conditions, restrictions, withdrawal history and authorised decision-making body where applicable.
